## Author Checklist

- [ ] The change has a bounded scope and targets the agreed branch.
- [ ] Required native task evidence covers the current submitted fix.
- [ ] Validation and independent review results are actual and current; limitations are stated.
- [ ] Source changes made after validation have refreshed evidence under Garda's lifecycle.
- [ ] Public attachments contain no credentials, private configuration, or unrelated workspace data.
- [ ] CI follows the explicit authorization policy; automatic triggers have been reconciled with a maintainer.
